title: Exodus 3:2 — God in thorns (burning bush)
summary: Exodus 3:2 (the angel of the LORD appears in a blazing fire in the bush, which burns but is not consumed) with the multicoloured caption GOD IN THORNS added at the bottom.

text.text: 2 The angel of the LORD appeared to him in a blazing fire from the midst of a bush; and he looked, and behold, the bush was burning with fire, yet the bush was not consumed.

uncertain: Moses is not named on the slide; 'him' refers to him in context. In the caption GOD the letters G, O, D are in different colours; only the L and R of LORD are coloured in the verse (meaning not stated).
